settings.ui.title: Interface
settings.ui.scrollHint: Thin scrollbars across the whole IDE — project tree, editor, our panels and popups. The platform's own are 10–14 px; 0 brings them back. Applied to open windows immediately.
settings.ui.promo: Offer paid JetBrains IDEs for “unsupported” files
settings.ui.promoHint: The platform can show an editor banner “*.tsx files are supported by WebStorm”. VibeIDEA supports such files through LSP, so the offer is off by default.
settings.ui.languageHint: The base language is compiled into the application. Other languages are files in {dir}: drop in en.json and the language appears in the list; delete it and it is gone. Format and sample: docs/vibe/manuals/langFileSpec.md. A change applies to new windows and panels.
settings.ui.createBaseFile: Create the base language file for editing
settings.ui.baseFileCreated: Created {path}. While this file exists it overrides the built-in strings — including typo fixes from newer versions.
watch.toolsMissing: not found: {tools}. Install with: brew install {install} (on Linux use your distribution's package manager). The binaries are not bundled: they are GPL builds that would have to be signed and updated together with the IDE.
watch.noVisionTarget: the selected target does not accept images — switch to a vision model or an agent that supports pictures
watch.textOnly: the target does not accept images — sending the transcript only
design.status.noAnswer: The page did not answer: nothing was measured
design.status.collectorMissing: The snapshot collector is missing from the plugin resources
design.status.noPanel: The VibeAgent panel is not open — nowhere to send it
design.jcefMissing: The embedded browser (JCEF) is unavailable in this build — there is nothing to measure with.
runs.empty.all: The ledger is empty: no HTTP API task and no pipeline has been started yet.
runs.note: Only unattended runs are recorded here — HTTP API tasks and pipelines; ordinary conversation lives in the chat history. Metadata only: no prompts, no model replies.
settings.chat.title: Chat
settings.chat.continueHint: The ▷ button to the right of the input sends this text as your message — a nudge when the agent has stopped. Empty restores “{default}”.
settings.chat.maxTabsHint: Beyond the limit the oldest inactive tab is closed quietly — the thread stays in the history.
settings.chat.maxMessagesHint: On overflow the oldest messages are trimmed, with a marker at the start of the thread.
history.export.title: History export
history.delete.title: History deletion
history.claim.title: History claiming
history.export.nothing: This project has no chat history to export.
history.delete.nothing: This project has no chat history.
history.delete.confirm:
Delete the entire chat history of this project ({count} threads)?

Only threads belonging to this project are affected. Threads without a project and those of other projects are left alone. This cannot be undone — export first.
history.claim.done: Claimed for this project: {count} chats without a project.
history.claim.nothing: There are no chats without a project — nothing to claim.
settings.providers.title: Providers
settings.providers.empty:
No active providers. Enable the ones you need in .vibe/providers/*.jsonc (active: true)
or create providers.json. Spec: docs/vibe/manuals/providersSpec.md.
settings.providers.checkTooltip: Ask the provider's model catalogue with the entered key and, if it is accepted, store it in the OS keychain
settings.providers.keyMissing: No key · chat with this provider will not work (except on localhost)
settings.providers.noBaseUrl: The provider has no baseURL — nothing to check
settings.providers.keyValid: Key is valid · the catalogue returned {count} models
settings.providers.keyNotNeeded: The catalogue returned {count} models · this endpoint needs no key
settings.providers.emptyCatalogAccepted: The endpoint answered, the catalogue is empty — the key is accepted (models come from the file)
settings.providers.emptyCatalogUnchecked: The endpoint answered but the catalogue is empty — the key cannot be verified (static list)
settings.models.title: Models
settings.models.activesOnlyTooltip: Show only the models enabled by their toggle (the ones visible in model pickers).
settings.models.refreshAllTooltip: Re-read the provider registry and ask each of them for its model list again
settings.models.refreshOneTooltip: Ask “{provider}” for its model list again
settings.models.allHidden: every model is hidden — turn off the “active only” toggle to enable catalogue models
settings.models.fetchDisabled: models are declared in the file (fetch: false)
settings.models.noKey: no key — the model catalogue is unavailable (Providers → key)
settings.models.catalogEmpty: the catalogue is empty — models come from the file only
